name: 钉钉
description: 钉钉 MCP：通讯录、部门、机器人消息/DING、待办、日程、工作通知、日志等能力。

composer.prompt: 使用钉钉插件查询或处理待办、日程、消息和审批相关事项，涉及写操作前先确认范围。

setup.instructions: 在钉钉开放平台创建企业内部应用，进入应用详情页「凭证与基础信息」获取 Client ID 与 Client Secret，并按需添加权限点；然后在 设置 → 环境变量 中配置 DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID 和 DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET。默认激活全部钉钉服务。

en.description: DingTalk MCP: contacts, departments, robot messages/DING, todos, calendar, work notices, and reports.

composer.prompt: Use the DingTalk plugin to query or handle todos, calendar, messages, and approvals; confirm scope before write actions.

setup.instructions: Create an internal app on the DingTalk Open Platform, get the Client ID and Client Secret from Credentials & Basic Info, grant the needed scopes, then set DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID and DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET in Settings → Environment Variables. All services are enabled by default; set DINGTALK_ACTIVE_PROFILES to narrow them.
